title: Small Business Saturday
seo_title: Small Business Saturday at Back Road Relics in Bolivar
description: Small Business Saturday is a shopping day at Back Road Relics, where the shop will be restocked and fresh baked cookies and punch will be served all day. The shop describes it as its only bonus shopping day of the year, with a couple of surprises planned. It runs Saturday, November 28, 2026, from 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM at 211 W Broadway St in Bolivar, Missouri.
address: 211 W Broadway St, Bolivar, MO 65613-1565, United States, Bolivar, MO
